issue.title: Portfolio: next five advancing chains after completed synthesis
issue.body:

State bounded next investments, first actions, counterevidence, stops and full cost limits or explicit unknowns, preserving stopped families and second-recast ordering.

This new investment question does not alter the completed foundations-special-review Issue #16.
